title: 1980 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Freddy Kottulinsky (Volkswagen Iltis) and Cyril Neveu (Yamaha)
summary: The 1980 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 20 stage towns and bivouacs through France, Algeria, Mali, Burkina Faso, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Freddy Kottulinsky (Volkswagen Iltis); Bikes: Cyril Neveu (Yamaha).

sources.label: The Drive: why VW entered its Iltis in the Paris–Dakar

approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.

stops.name: Paris
stops.text: The start of the second Paris–Dakar, with 216 competitors.

stops.name: Olivet
stops.text: Bivouac after the 4 km prologue near Orléans.

stops.name: Marseille
stops.text: A liaison south to Marseille; then three days' transport to Algeria.

stops.name: Algiers
stops.text: Stage 1 starts in Algiers after the crossing.

stops.name: In Salah
stops.text: Bivouac at the end of stage 1.

stops.name: Reggane
stops.text: Stage 2 begins: 270 km timed to Reggane.

stops.name: Bordj Badji Mokhtar
stops.text: A huge 630 km special south across the Tanezrouft to the Malian border.

stops.name: Gao
stops.text: Another 675 km special into Mali, won by Freddy Kottulinsky's VW Iltis, then a rest day in Gao.

stops.name: Mopti
stops.text: Stage 3 begins: 595 km to Mopti, Kottulinsky again fastest.

stops.name: Niono
stops.text: A liaison west to Niono.

stops.name: Tombouctou
stops.text: A 570 km special north to Timbuktu.

stops.name: Gao
stops.text: Back east along the Niger to Gao, the end of stage 3.

stops.name: Bobo-Dioulasso
stops.text: Stage 4: a liaison south into Upper Volta (today Burkina Faso).

stops.name: Kolokani
stops.text: Stage 5 back into Mali, then a rest day.

stops.name: Nioro du Sahel
stops.text: Stage 6 begins with 280 km timed.

stops.name: Kayes
stops.text: A 247 km special to Kayes to end stage 6.

stops.name: Bakel
stops.text: Stage 7: a liaison across the river into Senegal.

stops.name: Linguère
stops.text: Liaison on across the Senegalese savanna.

stops.name: Lompoul
stops.text: An 87 km special to the dunes of Lompoul near the Atlantic.

stops.name: Dakar
stops.text: The finish. Cyril Neveu won on a Yamaha for the second year running, Kottulinsky the cars in a VW Iltis, and Zohra Ataouat the first truck class.
